summary: xychart declares series but no x-axis line
help: Add an x-axis line that names the categories or range.
rationale: With the x-axis undeclared the horizontal scale and its labels are implicit, so the chart can mean something other than what the author intended.

summary: xychart declares series but no y-axis line
help: Add a y-axis line that names the value range.
rationale: With the y-axis undeclared the vertical scale or its units stay implicit, so a reader cannot tell what the plotted numbers mean.

summary: xychart declares no bar or line series
help: Add at least one bar [...] or line [...] series.
rationale: The grammar accepts axes alone, but the chart then has nothing to draw, and the empty output hides the mistake.

help: Give every series one value per x-axis category.
rationale: Series of unequal length line up against the wrong categories, so the drawn chart misrepresents the data.
